The administration claims canceling offshore wind leases protects economic interests and optimizes energy grids.
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, 0.0) — Good Preference

Taxpayers paid $3.9B to cancel clean leases, with funds diverted to highly polluting gas turbines and LNG terminals.
Resulting Judgement: (-1.0, -1.0) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — Fall into Destruction.
Paying billions to actively dismantle clean energy infrastructure to fund fossil fuels.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 12.5, Uncertainty z: 4)
The Trump administration paid $1.2B to German utility RWE to cancel wind leases, bringing total cancellation costs to $3.93B. RWE will pivot to natural gas.

The Poison:
While RWE maintains its global wind portfolio elsewhere, US taxpayers fund a forced regression back to fossil fuels under the guise of grid stability.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This is a WHAT vs WHO error. The pretext of saving money or protecting grids masks the active transfer of public wealth to fossil fuel interests.

Social Physics Analysis:
By prioritizing post-hoc justifications over upfront transparency, the policy hoards power for fossil fuel lobbies while projecting economic prudence.

The Trajectory: Fall into Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. Active regression.

The Unavoidable Truth: Public funds are being used to accelerate climate degradation.

The Unavoidable Lie: Canceling wind leases saves taxpayer money.

An audit of the capital flow reveals a highly inefficient, high-strain configuration designed to subsidize legacy energy at public expense.

It is heartbreaking to see billions of dollars that could have built a clean future instead spent on locking in decades of pollution.
